features.title: The TGS Advantage
features.subtitle: At Tokris Global Services Limited (TGS), we eliminate the linguistic friction that restricts international market entry. We facilitate cross-border communication through certified translation, sworn validation, international interpretation, and localized corporate training. From academic candidates positioning for international universities to multinational entities scaling into emerging markets, we provide culturally intelligent, high-precision solutions trusted worldwide.
features.f1Body: Backed by Certified & Professional Translators offering Sworn Translation Services across Over 100 Languages Supported.
features.f2Body: Guaranteeing a Fast & Reliable Turnaround with Strict Confidentiality & Data Security and rigorous Quality Assurance on Every Project.
features.f3Body: Driven by Affordable & Transparent Pricing, seamless Global Service Delivery, and Dedicated Customer Support.
features.f4Body: Express and same-day services are available. Receive your completed project securely and on time.

services.title: Professional language services, end to end
services.description: Whether you require Certified Translation, Sworn Translation, Interpretation, Localization, Transcription, Language Training, or Multilingual Business Support, our experienced team delivers accurate, confidential, and culturally intelligent solutions tailored to your needs.
services.translationBody: Professional translation across every document type, accurate, confidential, and delivered to the standard your receiving institution expects.
services.certifiedBody: Accepted by embassies, immigration authorities, universities, government agencies, courts, and international organizations. Every certified translation includes a professional statement of accuracy where applicable.
services.swornBody: Completed or validated by officially authorized translators for immigration applications, visa processing, court proceedings, embassy requirements, university admissions, and civil registration documents.
services.interpretationBody: Professional interpretation for conferences, meetings, courts, healthcare, businesses, and international events.
services.localizationBody: Expand globally with professionally localized content websites, software, mobile apps, marketing, e-commerce, product documentation, and multimedia.
services.transcriptionBody: Accurate transcription for interviews, podcasts, meetings, court proceedings, academic research, and medical and business recordings.
services.trainingBody: Professional language training for individuals, businesses, government agencies, NGOs, and corporate teams available both online and onsite.

formats.title: Interpretation in every format
formats.subtitle: From soundproof booths at international summits to whispered interpretation for VIP delegations, matched to the setting, the stakes, and the audience.
formats.fm1Body: Ideal for international conferences, diplomatic meetings, government events, corporate summits, workshops, seminars, and hybrid or virtual events.
formats.fm2Body: Suitable for business meetings, court proceedings, medical consultations, interviews, immigration interviews, negotiations, and training sessions.
formats.fm3Body: Ideal for executive meetings, VIP delegations, site visits, and factory tours.

formats.fm5Body: Interpretation booths, interpreter consoles, wireless receivers, headsets, conference audio systems, and technical support a complete solution for multilingual conferences and international events.

about.title: Your Trusted Partner for Global Language Solutions
about.description: At Tokris Global Services Limited, we believe language should never be a barrier to opportunity.
about.storyP1: We help people and organizations communicate across cultures through professional translation, sworn translation, interpretation, localization, transcription, language training, and multilingual communication services.
about.storyP2: From students applying to international universities to multinational corporations expanding into new markets, we provide language solutions that are accurate, culturally appropriate, and trusted worldwide. Every project is handled with professionalism, confidentiality, and an unwavering commitment to quality.
about.imageAlt1: A team collaborating around a table with notebooks and laptops
about.imageAlt2: Rows of books in a quiet library hall
about.visionBody: To become Africa's most trusted, premier, and globally recognized multi sector enterprise anchored in world class language solutions that empower people and organizations to communicate, operate, and scale across international borders without limits through continuous innovation, excellence, and deep cultural intelligence.
about.missionBody: To eliminate cross border friction by delivering flawless linguistic solutions, robust operational design, and agile resource procurement that accelerate global enterprise growth.

tokris.title: The TOKRIS framework
tokris.subtitle: Our name is our operating model, five integrated pillars that carry your enterprise from first translation to full international integration.
tokris.p1Body: Our baseline engine. We bridge critical communication gaps through elite linguistic precision while deployment ready tech ensures your data assets are structurally optimized for international scale.
tokris.p2Body: The operational pathway. We transform raw language assets into structured corporate workflows, providing lean project management and administrative advisory to streamline market entry.
tokris.p3Body: The intellectual core. We reinforce your operations with advanced language training, global compliance mapping, and localization insights to keep your brand culturally intelligent.
tokris.p4Body: The physical pipeline. We expand your infrastructure from words to tangible trade, facilitating global supply chain networks, secure international logistics, and cross-border execution.
tokris.p5Body: The ultimate destination. We synthesize translation, operational intelligence, knowledge systems, and physical resources to ensure your enterprise transitions seamlessly into any foreign market.

about.valuesSubtitle: Seven commitments, kept on every project regardless of size.
about.v1Body: Delivering outstanding quality in every project.
about.v2Body: Acting with honesty, transparency, and professionalism.
about.v3Body: Ensuring precision in every translation and interpretation.
about.v4Body: Safeguarding client information with the highest level of security.
about.v5Body: Putting our clients' success at the heart of everything we do.
about.v7Body: Respecting languages and cultures to ensure meaningful communication.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How much do your services cost?
faq.a1: Pricing depends on the language pair, document type, complexity, and turnaround time. Contact us for a quotation.
faq.a2: Delivery times vary depending on the project. Express and same day services are available.
faq.a3: Yes. Every project is handled with strict confidentiality and secure data management.
faq.q4: Do you provide Certified and Sworn Translation?
faq.a4: Yes. We offer both Certified and Sworn Translation services where required by the receiving institution or country.
faq.q5: Can you manage large multilingual projects?
faq.a5: Absolutely. We support projects of every size, from individual documents to enterprise-level multilingual assignments.
